newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW -- UK provisional M4, bank lending.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW -- UK provisional M4, bank lending.

text.p: Following is a selection of economists' reactions to UK data showing M4 rose a provisional S/A 11.1 percent year-on-year in May:

"It's the monetary side of a very strong economy and maybe one on the verge now of overheating that needs controlling action to be taken. I think we should see a half-point increase in base rates at the next meeting and I don't think that can be the end of the tightening in monetary policy this year.'

"Today's numbers will be something that catch the Bank of England's eye when it comes to assess interest rates again next month. I think there will be another tightening but the question is whether it comes immediately after the budget or whether Mr (Gordon) Brown does enough fiscal tightening that the Bank pauses for a little bit longer. But whatever happens, there is another increase in rates on the way."

"The figures today are going to be damaging to the gilt markets with such strong lending on the back of strong retail sales numbers. It is certainly going to put upward pressure on inflation expectations. It is now quite likely that base rates will rise in July unless the budget is especially tough on the personal sector."
